title: The Vocabulary Is Already Here: Adapting Pretrained Interpretable Features for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) predicts the next item through its semantic ID (SID). Existing methods commonly fit SID vocabularies to pretrained language model (PLM) representations of item descriptions, incurring additional training costs and making vocabulary coverage dependent on the fitting domains. We observe that pretrained sparse autoencoders expose PLM features with human-interpretable semantic annotations, allowing feature indices to serve as a reusable SID vocabulary. However, reusing this vocabulary requires preserving item distinctions under compact token budgets and learning to favor target items over candidates with shared dominant features. It also requires extending feature interpretability from item content to retrieval decisions. To address these challenges, we propose API, a framework that Adapts the Pretrained Interpretable vocabulary for effective and explainable GR without additional vocabulary learning. Within A

translated_title: 词表已然就绪：将预训练可解释特征适配于生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）通过语义ID（SID）来预测下一个物品。现有方法通常将SID词表拟合到预训练语言模型（PLM）对物品描述的表示上，这带来了额外的训练成本，并使词表覆盖率依赖于拟合的领域。我们观察到，预训练的稀疏自编码器能够揭示具有人类可解释语义标注的PLM特征，使特征索引可以作为可复用的SID词表。然而，复用该词表需要在紧凑的token预算下保持物品之间的区分度，并学习在具有相同主导特征的候选物品中偏向目标物品。这还需要将特征可解释性从物品内容扩展到检索决策。为应对这些挑战，我们提出API框架，通过适配预训练可解释词表，在无需额外词表学习的情况下实现有效且可解释的生成式推荐。
tldr: 该论文提出API框架，直接复用预训练稀疏自编码器的可解释特征索引作为生成式推荐的语义ID词表，无需额外的词表学习即可实现有效且可解释的推荐。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes API, a framework that reuses pretrained sparse autoencoder feature indices as semantic ID vocabularies for generative recommendation, achieving effective and explainable recommendation without additional vocabulary learning.
